about_the_game:
SaveSync is a co-op focused save syncing, backup, and sharing tool designed to make continuing shared game worlds easy and effortless. SaveSync ensures everyone in your group can pick up where you left off, without relying on the original host.

We built SaveSync after seeing how often players asked, “How can we keep playing our co-op world if the host isn’t available?” The usual answers, setting up a paid dedicated server or manually transferring files, are either expensive or frustrating. SaveSync solves this with a simple, automated and affordable solution.

Key Features

  • ☁️ Cloud Save Backup: Automatically backs up your co-op save files to the cloud.

  • 🔄 Cross-User Syncing: Share your save files with friends so anyone can continue hosting.

  • 🧭 Host Transfer Made Easy: The save’s host changes automatically when activated.

  • 🗂️ Save Activation Control: Activate or deactivate specific saves to get around in-game save limits–great for games that restrict the number of save slots.

  • 📂 Compliments Steam Cloud: Works alongside Steam Cloud without conflict. Save activation/deactivation and host changes reflect properly, even on unsupported platforms.

  • 🌐 LAN Sync – Seamlessly play non-Steam LAN games with your Steam friends.

  • 💾 Includes 500MB of Cloud Storage: Enough for most co-op games. Power users can buy more storage from inside the app.

  • 🎮 Games Currently supported: Please visit our website to check the list of supported games — click the "Visit the website" button on the store page.

We’re adding more games regularly. Want your favorite co-op game supported next? Create a request in the Community Hub discussions!

Data & Privacy

  • Our backend is securely hosted on Cloudflare, which handles save file storage and sync logic.

  • We do not store any personal data, only your Steam ID is retained for account linking and syncing.

  • Save files are never shared unless you explicitly choose to share them with friends.
